svg.text: Boktai cartridge ↔ ESP32-S3-CAM ↔ LTR390. Pins and GPIOs from OjoDelSolCalibrator/config.h. UNTESTED.
Pin order as in References/gba_cartridge_pinout.svg: pin 1 (VDD) left → pin 32 (GND) right
Status: on-board WS2812 LED, GPIO48 (no wiring)
All 3V3 labels are the same net (ESP32 3V3); all GND symbols and the GND rail are the same net (ESP32 GND). The cartridge is 3.3 V: no level shifter.
Pull-ups on /WR /RD /CS are optional; they only keep those lines idle while the ESP32 boots. /CS2 goes straight to 3V3, which keeps the save RAM deselected.
AD4 and AD7–AD15 are held low with 10 kΩ each (a direct tie to GND also works, since the cartridge drives zeros there). A16–A23 go straight to GND.
PHI (pin 2, CLK) and /REQ (pin 31, /IRQ) stay unconnected. Power off before inserting or removing the cartridge.
ESP32 pads run in the physical order of the board's right-hand header, bottom to top (USB-C ports at the bottom), so the wires do not cross: 21, 47, 38, 39, 40, 41, 42, 2, 1.
